alt: Farah follows the Kalman update loop and checks its noise assumptions on the lab wall.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Recompose the LAST reference into a 1536x1024 landscape Deep Orbit lesson scene. References 1 through 1 are canonical identity authorities in this order: dr-farah. Reference 2 is the room authority; reference 3 is the original edit target for story action, lighting and palette only. Preserve exact recognizable canonical facial structure, eye spacing, nose, jaw, mouth, complexion, age and signature equipment. Exactly 1 humans, the named cast only. Preserve balanced adult proportions and candid expressions. Exactly two complete arms per person, each from its own shoulder through one elbow and neutral wrist to one plausible hand. Ordinary thumb sides, fingers and natural object contact; no extra arm or bent prop. No camera-facing portraits. Faces visible naturally three-quarter with eyes directed toward work or each other. Use available empty wall or upper space for a large upright primary lesson display that is physically plausible and faces its operators. All text and lines follow the display plane, crisp and generously sized with comfortable margins. Keep essential content fully visible. Never put the sole lesson evidence upside down on paper or flat table, or on a tiny tabletop screen beneath a blank wall. Secondary paper can face its owner, but essential content is repeated upright. Remove meaningless decorative technical labels. No generic success verdicts, invented numbers, speech bubbles, watermarks or signatures. Dr. Farah: medium-brown skin, dark tied hair, gray lab coat, earrings and translucent green AR lens over her left eye.
Specific action and staging: Farah studies the filter cycle on the newly used large upright lab wall while adjusting a tactile dial with one hand; her other hand rests on the bench. Keep her curious analytical expression and warm face light. No held pen.
Exact visible display content: Title "Scalar Kalman update". Four linked boxes in a clear loop: "Predict variance" to "Compute gain" to "Correct estimate and variance" to "Next reading", returning to first. Parameter strip "Q = 0.1", "R = 1", "Initial variance = 1". Footer "A level model; daily change is not a state". Large readable labels with exact connections.
cel-shaded cartoon illustration, clean bold linework, flat shading with one soft key light, cinematic character and environment framing, near-black space, green #6BAA8A interface glow, warm brass #A89060 trim, cohesive Deep Orbit series look, not photorealistic.

defects.repairDirection: Move the cycle and verified variance assumptions to the large lab wall. Keep Farah operating the filter with simple hands and a readable main display.

ownReview.narrativeReason: The uncertainty update controls how the new reading changes the estimate.
